human_identity_constraints.jwt_verification: local verification with pinned issuer, audience, and JWKS policy

secret_materialization_policy.encrypted_files: only SOPS-encrypted env/enc/*.env.enc files may be tracked
secret_materialization_policy.materialization: reviewed just recipe, SOPS-aware Nix activation outside the Nix store, or runtime secret provider

role_contracts.api_service: Owns public APIs, webhooks, authorization, validation, and orchestration.
role_contracts.client_sdk: Depends on interfaces and exposes generated clients plus thin wrappers.
role_contracts.composition_workspace: Composes source repositories and records the release BOM.
role_contracts.end_to_end_tests: Runs black-box compatibility and user-flow checks.
role_contracts.infrastructure: Owns product cloud resources; promotion remains GitOps-controlled.
role_contracts.interfaces: Own OpenAPI, events, JSON Schema, compatibility fixtures, and DTO inputs.
role_contracts.mcp_server: Calls product SDKs/APIs; no parallel domain persistence.
role_contracts.sync_service: Owns product conflict policy/adapters and wraps Opto reconciliation.
role_contracts.web_bff: Owns browser sessions, CSRF, HTML/SSR, and calls the product API.

service_boundary_policy.mcp_database_access: forbidden-by-default; MCP calls the product API/SDK
service_boundary_policy.preferred_cross_service_calls: typed API/SDK, event, or owned replicated read model
